name: Andaz Lisbon
insider_take: This sleek contemporary hotel perfectly captures Lisbon's dynamic blend of historic charm and modern creativity, situated in the heart of the city's cultural renaissance.
whats_special: The Andaz Lisbon showcases stunning Portuguese azulejo-inspired design elements throughout its interiors, while offering panoramic views of the Tagus River and the iconic 25 de Abril Bridge. The hotel's rooftop bar features locally-sourced Portuguese wines and craft cocktails with unobstructed sunset views over the city's seven hills.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room and time your arrival for golden hour – the light reflecting off the Tagus creates an unforgettable first impression of Lisbon's beauty.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps away from LX Factory, Lisbon's hippest creative hub housed in a former industrial complex, and just minutes from the historic Belém district where you can taste the original pastéis de nata at the legendary Pastéis de Belém bakery.
pros: Prime location in Príncipe Real with easy access to historic neighborhoods
Contemporary design blending modern luxury with Portuguese heritage
Rooftop terrace offering panoramic views of Lisbon
Hyatt Privé Program benefits including room upgrades and dining credits
cons: Limited on-site parking in busy downtown area
Higher price point reflecting luxury positioning
